notes.title: Current status about Project VTS
notes.content: [p]Till 2025.06.07, it's about a year since the Early Access of Project VTS, I didn't fulfill my promise that I will release 1.0 after 2-5 months, although there are less than 100 players who have played my game up to today, I still have to say a sorry to all the players of Project VTS.[/p][p][/p][p]Since the game was released, I have never been satisfied with its completeness and gameplay. Till today, I've been working on a overhaul of this game, and it seems about to complete within 2-3 month, which should release with a Demo.[/p][p][/p][p]But still I can't trust my self anymore, I'm not sure will I complete it within the time I thought or not.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Till 2025.06.07, this game is in version OP05, which is not fun from my opinion, and lots of bugs, but I can't fix it because I only got overhauled project files.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]To the players who still have this game now, I'm grateful for your purchase. You have provided me with considerable motivation to continue making it. Although I think it's necessary for me to offer unconditional refunds, obviously my financial situation doesn't support me to do so.[/p][p]For the players who want to buy this game, I suggest that you don't purchase this game until you see the update with the title "PVTS". From my perspective as a player, this game can be said to be quite boring at present and full of various unplayable bugs.[/p][p][/p][p]The decision is yours. I would appreciate any form of your support[/p]
